The Router marked this as 'N/A', missing a potential taxonomic mismatch. Additionally, the Router failed to flag the limb-like structures near the tail as a structural anomaly, treating the subject purely as a snake despite visual evidence suggesting a legless lizard (slow worm) morphology.

These are inconsistent with the 'thunder snake' taxonomy (which is limbless) and suggest either a generation artifact (fusion/hallucination) or a misclassification of the subject as a slow worm (which has vestigial limbs). The open_vocabulary_detector's high confidence score (0.81) for 'limbs' in the tail region strongly supports the presence of these anomalous structures. This structural defect warrants a moderate artifact penalty.
